summary: Focused regression test of the PDF export bug fix (Report button now uses axios blob download with withCredentials) plus the cookie auth flow it depends on. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed (login sets httpOnly access_token, /auth/me with & without cookie, report 200+application/pdf for lang=en/id/invalid, 401 'Not authenticated' with no/bad cookie, Bearer token path, unknown project 404). Frontend: logged in via visible form as admin@cqas.local, opened Navapark NBS-DEMO project, clicked data-testid='download-report-button' -> real browser download 'concrete-quality-report-NBS-DEMO.pdf' whose bytes start with %PDF; intercepted /api/projects/{id}/report?lang=en and ?lang=id responses were 200 with Content-Type application/pdf. No 'Not authenticated' text and no error elements on the page. Bug is FIXED. PDF text extraction confirms EN/ID localization of headings, statuses and recommendations.

minor.issue: PDF 'Generated:' date is not localized in ID mode (renders English month, e.g. 'Dibuat: 27 August 2026')
Age column renders 'None day' / 'None hari' when age_days is missing (should be '—'), and floats render as '28.0 day' instead of '28 days' (reports.py formatting)

issues: 'Jalankan ulang analisis' button label wraps to 3 lines, making the three hero buttons visually uneven in height

action_items: Optional: localize the report generation date for lang=id in /app/backend/reports.py
Optional: fix age formatting in the PDF ('None day' -> '—', '28.0 day' -> '28 days')
Cleanup: leftover QA seed data pollutes the demo dataset (8 TEST_CQAS_* projects and TEST-*/UI-* records inside the NBS-DEMO project appear in dashboard and PDF)
critical_code_review_comments: downloadReport correctly revokes the object URL and surfaces errors via setMessage; error fallback uses the generic upload-failed translation key which is misleading for report failures - consider a dedicated 'report failed' message

Report endpoint has no record-count guard; a project with thousands of records builds the whole PDF in memory (to_list(5000)) synchronously in the event loop - consider run_in_threadpool for build_report
seed_data_creation: None created this iteration (used existing seeded admin + NBS-DEMO project)
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF export regression verified fixed end-to-end. Reusable pytest suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_report_export.py. Project cards with data-testid='project-card-*' exist only on /projects; on /dashboard use the 'Recent work' text links. NBS-DEMO project id at time of test: 0981ebed-f920-4983-9012-b8d5705eaae1. access_token cookie is httpOnly, SameSite=None, sent on XHR. Untested this iteration (out of scope): mapping templates, settings, OCR/upload flows.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 401 came from a top-level <a target=_blank> navigation to the API URL which browsers no longer reliably attach the SameSite cookie to. The fix (axios GET with withCredentials + responseType blob + createObjectURL download) sends the httpOnly cookie on an XHR; verified via network interception returning 200 application/pdf.
